title: Visual Logic & Code Trace Explainer

sourceFile: Chaos to Solution - EdTech & Open Innovation Challenges.pdf

resource: A compiled dataset of 100 common beginner compiler error messages and stack traces.
sourceFile: Chaos to Solution - EdTech & Open Innovation Challenges.pdf

title: Sub-1MB Interactive Lecture Checkpoint Web Page

sourceFile: Chaos to Solution - EdTech & Open Innovation Challenges.pdf
